ISOLATION.description: Inspect preview-only selection versus production allowlist, actionable feature errors, real article figures and negative leak evidence.

DEPENDENCIES.description: Review exact lock/graph, install/render costs, two different profiles and old/new behavior; no weakened resource budgets or hidden install.

CROSS-REPO.description: Record the common ownership/upgrade decision in #2 and linked Subprime48/PR46, actual independent pins/gaps and UA133/deck disposition. No sibling merge/closure is implied.

EDITORIAL.description: Review the complete PMDay text and authored platform adaptation against blueprint, exact sources, attribution/rights and feedback classification. Source protocols are separate from reader prose.

IDENTITIES.description: Inspect source-qualified meaningful tests and current legacy records, stable identities, independent adaptation revision and same-edition rerender.

READER.description: Inspect actual browser reader/navigation/head/history/anchors/focus/scroll/cache/cancellation, Off/reduced/no-Canvas/no-JS/print, nested Pages base, archives/served bytes and unchanged five-room budgets.

PLATFORMS.description: Inspect authored furniture, actual heading-link/caption/alt/asset behavior, Medium ordered upload fallback and two profile candidates; native-editor acceptance remains external.

PUBLICATION.description: Verify append-only observed events, preservation of historical originals and absence of fabricated live canonical/date/state. Actual #2:AC04–AC06 publication/rights/upstream decisions remain pending until separately observed.

INDEPENDENT.description: Independent architecture/export review of exact implementation and applicable CS01–CS10 plus RI/CI/source-profile dispositions. Bounded guard success alone is insufficient.

DELIVERY.description: Inspect exact PR/head/tree/CI/hosted staging and AC reconciliation before delivery. Merge and public activation require their applicable owner decision; green checks do not authorize them.
